title: learning_block's trace proof reaches codemother only through her interface
intention: learning_block's trace proof imports nothing of codemother's, and the clearance half of a9709b744bf5's clause 4 is proven in codemother's own clearance proofs.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 (akienasus asked for the ticket): line 127 of cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/test_a_trace_file_name_is_legal_on_every_box.py imports cairn.devices.codemother.machines.clearance.clearance. Codemother does not publish that machine, so encapsulation_holds reds it. RULE 1 lets code outside a device reach it only through the bus or a tool it publishes.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation); Law 9 (a standing red is fixed, or it carries a decision)
how: Remove the clearance block from the learning_block clause-4 tooth and add an AST tooth showing learning_block imports no codemother. Add a codemother clearance proof that seeds the same harbor_master:clearance lines into a legacy-only store and a new-name-only store under CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT, and counts read_attempts the same over both.

clauses.claim: no .py file under cairn/machines/learning_block/ imports cairn.devices.codemother (AST read)
learning_block's every_reader_counts_the_same_over_either_store still counts the intent, sorted and saveslate readers the same over a legacy-only and a new-name-only store, intent at (2, 1)
codemother's clearance read_attempts counts 2 attempts and 1 unreadable line over a legacy-only store and over a new-name-only store, and the two counts are equal

decisions.text: D1: in test_a_trace_file_name_is_legal_on_every_box.py, _counts drops the clearance import and its count. blocks and _seed_lines drop harbor_master:clearance, and the clearance assert goes. A new tooth, no_learning_block_file_imports_codemother, walks cairn/machines/learning_block/**/*.py by AST. PROVES gains 30896d454418 {1: that tooth, 2: every_reader_counts_the_same_over_either_store}.

D2: a new proof, cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance_counts_the_same_over_either_trace_store.py, carries clause 3. It copies the harbor_master:clearance seed lines verbatim from the learning_block proof's _seed_lines (two records and a 'not json' line). It sets CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT to a scratch_dir, writes a legacy-only store and then a new-name-only store, and asserts read_attempts gives (2, 1) for both, equal. On POSIX the legacy name is the colon name. On Windows it uses learning_block's legacy_trace_path seam, patched and then restored. Importing cairn.machines.learning_block is legal: it is a top-level machine.

measured.saw: line 127 of the learning_block trace proof imports cairn.devices.codemother.machines.clearance.clearance, and codemother's clearance charter publishes only the queueme verb and its module CLI
measured.how: read the proof at origin/main, and read public_interface in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/intention+why.json
